subject: Add safe Work Item updates
description:
## What to build

Implement `tm update <id>` for safe Subject, Description, and Agent Context edits.

## Acceptance criteria

- `tm update <id>` safely updates Subject, Description, and Agent Context.
- Existing validation rules are reused.
- Lifecycle state, dependencies, claims, Result, and Cancellation are not modified by update.
- `updatedAt` advances only after successful mutation.
- Tests cover successful and failed updates.
- `bun run check` passes.

subject: Add structured cancellation
description:
## What to build

Implement `tm cancel <id>` with structured Cancellation, claim conflict rules, cascade behavior, and list filters.

## Acceptance criteria

- `tm cancel` transitions open Work Items to `cancelled` with structured Cancellation.
- Parent cancellation cascades to open descendants only with `--yes`.
- Active claim conflicts require `--force`.
- Cancelled Work Items are inspectable through list filters and show.
- Tests cover cancellation lifecycle and filtering.
- `bun run check` passes.

subject: Add destructive delete
description:
## What to build

Implement `tm delete <id> --yes` with subtree deletion and dangling dependency protection.

## Acceptance criteria

- `tm delete <id> --yes` deletes the selected Work Item and descendants.
- Running without `--yes` previews and fails without mutation.
- Deletion refuses to create dangling dependencies.
- Docs warn that cancellation is preferred for real work.
- Tests cover destructive and failed paths.
- `bun run check` passes.

## Source

Derived from `specs/prds/p1-04-implement-delete-command.md`.
agentContext:
## Execution context

Follow `specs/prds/p1-04-implement-delete-command.md` for `tm delete <id> --yes` implementation requirements, including destructive confirmation, preview without `--yes`, dependency safety, docs, tests, and `bun run check`.

## Relevant project context

- Relevant files named by the PRD: `packages/cli/src/main.ts`, `packages/cli/src/domain/WorkItem.ts`, `packages/cli/src/domain/Validation.ts`, `packages/cli/src/storage/TaskStore.ts`, and `packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts`.
- Preserve cancellation as the recommended path for real work; deletion is for accidental records.

## Source

Derived from `specs/prds/p1-04-implement-delete-command.md`.

## Verification expectations

- Add tests for destructive leaf deletion, preview failure without `--yes`, subtree deletion, unrelated Work Items, dangling dependency refusal, allowed internal-subtree dependents, human-output, JSON-output, and validation after deletion.
- Run `bun run check`.
